notes.title: Hanctt Origins 1.1 Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hanctt Origins - Update 1.1 Patch Notes


 Sensitivity settings have been fixed.
 Visual bug in the HUD has been fixed.
 A number of visual bugs have been fixed and improved.
 New sound effects have been added and some existing sounds have been updated.
 The character's walking sensation has been made smoother.
 Statistics such as health and armor were not reloaded at each level.
 Bugs related to recoil and camera shake have been fixed.
 Some optimization improvements have been made. However, additional improvements that will further improve performance will be available with the upcoming Act 2 update.


Your feedback is important to us! Enjoy the game!

notes.title: v1.0 FULL Version OUT NOW! 🥳
notes.notes:
New Features and Updates

Merchant System


 Encounter merchants every few levels.
 Purchases: Buy bullets, medkits, and armor.
 Weapons: Discover new weapons in their inventory.
 Sell Items: Trade valuable items for Ichor, the rare currency of the Hanctt District.


Gab’s Outfit Evolution


 Evolve Gab’s uniforms for unique perks:
 Perks: Run faster, gain 5 seconds of immortality, and more!
 Balance Your Skills: Don’t spend all your skill points on weapons—Gab deserves some attention too!


New Weapons


 E-S16: A fast and reliable close-range pistol.
 Gaze: Take down enemies from long distances with precision.
 Cultist's Fury: A high-rate-of-fire machine gun.
 Dual Cultist's Fury: Unleash chaos with dual machine guns!
 Dagon's Fang: Slash your enemies.


New Levels


 Continue Gab’s journey across the Hanctt Continent with 30 new levels.
 Explore New Regions: Battle through Modkefn, Swojkord, Ludtern, and Insmouth in search of Lina.


Optimization Settings


 FSR Support: FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) added to graphics options.
 FPS drops are minimized for a smoother gameplay experience.


New Menus and Gameplay Mechanics


 ACT Menu: Replay your favorite levels anytime.
 TAB Menu: Upgrade your weapons during gameplay. Remember, you need to visit the merchant to upgrade!
 New Objective Menu: Track your goals and manage missions with ease.
 Change Difficulty Menu: Adjust the difficulty whenever you like.


New Enemy Types


 Face enemies specifically designed for the new regions, making battles more challenging and diverse.


Full Version and What’s Next

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191573/28dc776c5397ead6a6bf7f782f02e8b6422e6820.png


 Act I Complete: The full version of Hanctt Origins is now live!
 Act II & New Hero: In future updates, explore the remote areas of the Hanctt Continent with Captain Elara. Prepare for new gameplay mechanics and thrilling adventures!


Bug Fixes and Improvements


 Performance issues resolved.
 Graphics and optimization tweaks applied.
 Various minor bug fixes completed.


Prepare yourself for the full Hanctt Origins experience! Good luck on Gab’s quest to find Lina.
Spend your Ichor wisely, upgrade your gear, and uncover the secrets of the Hanctt Continent!
